page.title: Agents
page.intro: Agents are the specialists your workflows hand work to: one reads your app, another writes the script, another edits the footage. Pick them when you build a workflow.
page.legend: The lock marks a built-in agent: it is ready to use as it is but cannot be edited. To change how one behaves, create your own with New agent. The external-link icon opens an agent's page.
page.emptyBody: Agents will appear here once the system is configured.
